visual.description: Deep dark navy used as the primary page background throughout the site.
Slightly darker navy surface used for card and testimonial backgrounds.
Semi-transparent dark navy used for the navigation bar at top of page.
Opaque dark navy used for the navigation bar after scroll.
Pure white used for primary headings and bold UI text.
Off-white used for body copy and secondary text content.
Muted purple-grey used for subdued text, footer links, and inactive states.
White used for navigation links in the top-of-page state.
White used for navigation links after scroll.
Vibrant orange-red used for primary CTA buttons like 'Sign up for free'.
Deep red-orange accent used for brand logo mark and highlighted headline text.
Muted purple-navy used for card borders and subtle dividers.
Slightly lighter dark surface used for interactive cards and update panels.
Deep purple gradient glow visible in the hero section background behind the headline.
Deep crimson-red gradient glow used in the lower hero background creating a warm depth effect.
Mid-purple used in the hero section gradient blending between warm red and dark navy.
Bright orange-red used for footer section category headings like 'Company'.
Purple used for the 'App' footer section heading.
Amber/yellow used for the 'Use Cases' footer section heading.
Cyan used for the 'Social' footer section heading.
Green used for the 'Updates' footer section heading.
Blue used for hyperlinks within the page content.
Indigo/purple used as background accent for recurring tasks feature card.
Red used as background accent for quick-add feature card.
Sky blue used as background accent for recurring tasks and widget feature cards.
